methods.name: DBSANet (Dual-Branch Semantic Aggregation Network)
methods.summary: DBSANet is a U-shaped encoder-decoder semantic segmentation network. Its encoder uses a dual-branch parallel structure integrating ResNet-18 (for local features) and Swin Transformer (for global context). It features a Feature Fusion Module (FFM) to aggregate branch outputs and a Spatial Gate Attention Module (SGAM) in the skip connections to bridge the semantic gap between encoder and decoder.
methods.source: Yankui Li, Wu Zhu, et al.
methods.verbatim: In this study, we propose a new semantic segmentation model named DBSANet for landslide detection.
